div.div: مُتَطَرِّفٌ A man who does not, or will not, keep constantly to an affair; [but I think that امر (which I have rendered “ an affair ”) in my original is evidently a mistranscription for ٱمْرَأَة, i. e. a woman, or wife;] as also ↓ مُسْتَطْرِفٌ . (TA.) See also طَرِفٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
